feed.title: Windhawk Mod Updates
feed.subtitle: Updates in the official collection of Windhawk mods

entry.title: Taskbar System Utilities 1.3
entry.content:
• Custom Menu Items: Added support for launching custom programs, files, folders, scripts, URLs, ms-settings: pages, and shell: locations directly from the Windows 11 taskbar context menu (includes Terminal and Control Panel by default).
  • Rich Item Customization: Each custom entry supports environment variable expansion (e.g., %USERPROFILE%), optional command-line arguments, Segoe Fluent Icons hex glyphs or emojis, Run as administrator (UAC elevation), Hide window, separator lines (-), and disabled section headings (items without a command).
  • Flexible Menu Layout & Submenus: Added options to place custom items below built-in items (bottom), above them (top), or inside the System Utilities submenu (submenu), group custom items into their own dedicated submenu with a custom name and icon, and choose top or bottom placement for System Utilities.
  • Improved Unload Lifecycle: Added weak-reference tracking for injected menu items and click handlers to cleanly detach and hide elements when the mod is unloaded or updated.

entry.title: Background Dimmer 1.1.1
entry.content: • Hotkeys now need Win plus at least one of Ctrl, Alt or Shift, so a hotkey can't take over typing keys (Shift+letter) or the Win+letter keys Windows uses. Saved hotkeys that don't follow this stop working and must be set again.

entry.title: Taskbar Active Window Highlight 0.1.1
entry.content:
Taskbar Active Window Highlight

When an app has several windows, Windows 11's thumbnail preview gives no hint about which one is active. This mod adds an accent-colored highlight to the active window's card. The taskbar button keeps Windows' native indicator.

Requires the Windows 11 taskbar's XAML thumbnail previews (tested on Windows 11 build 26300). With the classic thumbnails, or with StartAllBack or ExplorerPatcher, the mod has no effect.

How it works

The mod does not track focus itself. It reads the state Explorer already keeps:

  • The taskbar's active task item (TaskbarAppsList.ActiveItem), which names the active window. The mod follows Explorer's own change notifications.
  • Each thumbnail card's view model, which names the window the card shows.

The highlight is a separate element placed right above the card's own background, below the title, icon and preview image. Its size and corner radius are bound to that background, so it follows themes such as Windows 11 Taskbar Styler.

Clicking the taskbar or a preview list briefly moves focus to the taskbar itself. By default the last active window stays highlighted until another window or the desktop takes focus, or the window is minimized or closed.

How it differs from Taskbar Recent Focus Highlight

Taskbar Recent Focus Highlight ranks apps and windows by recent use, from its own focus history. This mod answers a narrower question, which window is active right now, by reading Explorer's own active task item, with no focus tracking of its own. While another app has focus it marks nothing in this app's preview, and it also marks single-window previews.

Performance and footprint

  • Event-driven only. No background thread, timers, polling or focus tracking. The mod runs only when Explorer reports a new active window or binds a preview card to a window.
  • Nothing on hover or layout. Moving the mouse over the taskbar or previews runs no mod code.
  • Under 1 ms, usually about 0.01 ms. Measured in normal use: typical 0.004–0.013 ms per event, worst case 0.67 ms (the first time a card's highlight is created).
  • One element per card, created once and then only shown or hidden.
  • Safe to unload. No event handlers are left in Explorer, so disabling the mod cleanly removes it.

entry.title: 1 Letter Language Indicator 1.0
entry.content:
1 Letter Language Indicator

Simplifies the input language indicator in the Windows 11 taskbar tray to a single letter: ENG becomes E, and ENG (US) becomes E.

The indicator keeps updating when you switch input languages, and the original text is restored when the mod is disabled.

Settings

  • Letter size: the font size of the letter. Set it to 0 to keep the Windows size (12).
  • Letter color: separate colors for light mode and dark mode, chosen by the taskbar's theme (the Windows mode). Each one can be:
    • A hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) or a color name (Red, White).
    • accent for the Windows accent color, or one of its shades: accentLight1 to accentLight3, accentDark1 to accentDark3. The letter follows accent color changes.
    • Empty, to keep the Windows color in that mode.
  • Vertical offset: moves the letter up (negative) or down (positive), in pixels. Useful for re-centering the letter after changing its size.
  • Indicator width: the language indicator normally reserves room for three letters. With a single letter that leaves empty space, so by default the indicator is narrowed to 32 pixels, the width of a regular tray icon. Set it to 0 to keep the Windows width.

Notes

  • Languages and layouts which start with the same letter look the same, e.g. ENG (US) and ENG (UK), or ENG and ESP.
  • Other mods may set the same properties. "Taskbar tray icon spacing and grid" sets the width of the language indicator: while Indicator width is set, this mod's width wins. Windows 11 Taskbar Styler themes which change the font size or color of the indicator conflict with Letter size and Letter color, and whichever mod applies last wins. To let the other mod control a property, set the matching setting to 0 (or leave the color empty).

Target

SystemTray.LanguageTextIconContent > Grid#ContainerGrid >
SystemTray.AdaptiveTextBlock#LanguageInnerTextBlock > TextBlock#InnerTextBlock

Only Windows 11 is supported.

entry.title: System Tray Folders 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Fixed the flyout's icon list not being found on Windows builds where it has no name.
  • Added a List view option that shows the flyout as one column with each icon's name next to it, plus List view width.
  • Added an Add icon... tile inside each folder that lists the tray icons by app name, shows which folder each one is in, and moves icons in or out with a click. Picks are remembered by the mod and take priority over the patterns.

entry.content: • Fix more dialogs

entry.title: WinTips OSD 1.6.1
entry.content:
• Added a solo-Shift inference fallback for the input language tip: third-party IMEs that never answer WM_IME_CONTROL now get their Chinese/English mode tracked by the classic solo Shift press-and-release gesture. A 350 ms grace window gives the system read a chance to report the toggle first; odd numbers of solo Shift releases flip the cached mode, even numbers settle silently, and Shift+letter, Alt+Shift and Ctrl+Shift all drop out of the gesture on their own. The inference only applies to Chinese IME layouts.
  • Caps Lock now opens the language watch as well, so IMEs that toggle Chinese/English with it (Weasel's default, Sogou's option) report the mode on the language card.
  • Copy, paste and cut tips no longer fire when Win is held: Win+Ctrl+V opens the Volume Mixer and Win+Ctrl+C toggles color filters. Ctrl+Shift+V stays a paste.
  • Updated the readme.

entry.title: Start Button Replacer 1.0.0
entry.content:
• Added SVG support for all image sources (local files and HTTP/HTTPS URLs ending in .svg). Only static SVG content is rendered.
  • Added optional Dark mode images that replace the main images while Windows is in dark mode. Blank fields use the main images, and images switch automatically when the Windows mode changes.
  • Image load warnings now show which settings group the failed image belongs to.
  • Added a Credits section to the readme. Thanks to Asteski for SVG support and dark mode images.

entry.title: Window Centralizer 1.2.0
entry.content:
• Windows shown with SetWindowPlacement are now centered. Programs that restore a saved position this way (7-Zip's file manager) were left where they were, whatever the size limit.
  • New option, Center on the unrelated launcher window (Parent mode only): a program started from another one, such as from Explorer's context menu or an archive opened from a folder, opens centered on the window it was started from (if inside the window size limit target). That window is the one in the foreground when the new process starts, and it must belong to the launching program (any Explorer process counts), so programs started from Start or the taskbar still open at the center of the monitor.
  • Hotkeys now require Win, at least one more modifier (Ctrl, Alt or Shift) and a key; other combinations are rejected, so a hotkey such as Shift+letter can't catch ordinary typing.

entry.title: Task Manager Pause Button 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Keeps Pause active when switching between Processes and Details, and resumes Task Manager updates when opening other pages.
  • Restores direct support for opening Task Manager on Details, using the available navigation symbols while avoiding duplicate hooks for shared function addresses.
  • Adds Frame.Navigated handling as a fallback for page detection and refresh-state changes.
  • Improves command-bar detection and retries button insertion when the toolbar is not ready.
  • Keeps the Pause/Resume button usable with its text label if the native icon cannot be created.
  • Improves cleanup of button and navigation event handlers when disabling the mod.

entry.title: Winstant 1.6
entry.content: -there’s a new setting, “Open the panel by hovering the minimize button” (Panel group). Turn it off and the panel opens only with the hotkey or key taps. The mouse wheel on the minimize button keeps its own option.

entry.title: Adobe Dark Menus 1.1.0
entry.content:
• Fixed a crash on exit, seen in InDesign and Audition.
  • Fixed the scroll arrows of long menus when Menu Background Color is mid gray or lighter.
  • Fixed submenus drawn by Windows taking the custom background of an app-drawn parent menu.
  • Fixed dark title bars on right-to-left windows.
  • Fixed a case where dropdown list colors could stay on after the list was gone.
  • No more arrow flicker after scrolling a long menu with the keyboard, and less work while the mouse moves over one.
  • Safer when the mod is turned off or updated while an app is running.
  • Added a Scroll Long Menus Instead of Columns setting, on by default: a menu an app splits into columns, such as the After Effects Effect menu with many plugins installed, now opens as one dark column that scrolls instead of staying light.
  • Added InCopy, Lightroom and Lightroom Classic.
  • Added the Beta versions of Premiere Pro, InDesign, InCopy and Audition.

• New option to show or hide file extensions in the card's name, or follow File Explorer's setting.

entry.title: Explorer Item Pins 1.1.5
entry.content:
Explorer Item Pins

English · Русский

Explorer Item Pins keeps selected files and folders at the top of their parent folder in Windows File Explorer. Each folder has its own pins.

Features
  • Two ways to pin. Use the modern context menu or the pin button between Share and Delete on the command bar.
  • Sort and group. Pins stay at the top in either sort direction. With grouping on, they appear in the first group, Pinned. Explorer's sorting still applies within the group.
  • Pin indicator. A pushpin appears at the upper-right corner of the file or folder icon. It follows the icon size and works with thumbnails, lists, details, tiles and content view.
  • Interface languages. English, Russian, Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese.

Platforms

Requires Windows 11 x64 or ARM64 with the tabbed File Explorer.

Data exchange

Pins are stored separately for each Windows account. Uninstalling the mod removes its pins. Replacing a file under the same name keeps its pin. A rename within the same folder can keep the pin when the mod can identify the original file. Copying or moving an item to another folder does not carry its pin with it.

Usage

  1. Select a file or folder and choose Pin in item pane in its context menu, or click the pin on the command bar.
  2. To remove the pin, select the item and choose Unpin from item pane or click the crossed-out pin on the command bar. The item returns to its usual position in the folder.

In Windhawk, open the mod's Settings to control these options independently. All three are enabled by default.

If the pin commands are missing from a File Explorer window that was already open when the mod was enabled or updated, reopen that window.

Setting Controls
Context menu command Pin and unpin in the context menu
Command bar button Pin and unpin on the File Explorer command bar
Pinned item indicator The pushpin on pinned file and folder icons

Links

  • Explorer Item Pins on GitHub
  • DSN Windhawk Mods

entry.title: Top Taskbar Bleed 1.2.1
entry.content:
• A Windows mode or accent change while a bleed is showing no longer leaves the taskbar with a background computed for the previous theme: the taskbar’s background element is kept on the Windows mode’s theme while the mod forces the panel’s theme on the rest of the bar
  • The background element’s theme is left alone when it already has an explicit RequestedTheme of its own (a Taskbar Styler style); a local Default, which the taskbar leaves there and which inherits like an unset value, is pinned over and put back when the mod releases it
  • README theme note updated

entry.content:
• The taskbar now appears alongside Search, including over fullscreen apps.
  • Support for the new Search UI in Windows Insider builds.
  • New setting to turn off showing the taskbar with Search.
  • Simplified readme and settings text.

entry.title: Taskbar Network Speed Indicator 1.7
entry.content:
• Added custom font family setting (fontFamily) with fallback to Segoe UI.
  • Added bold text styling toggle (isBold).
  • Added custom HEX color settings (textColor and uploadColor).
  • Added dynamic text measurement to expand widget width and prevent font clipping.

entry.title: Notepad++ Dark Dialog Fix 1.0.3
entry.content:
Notepad++ Dark Dialog Fix

In dark mode, Notepad++ paints its Save and confirm dialogs dark but leaves the text black, so you can barely read it. This mod makes that text light again.

Features

  • Readable dialog text in Save, Save changes and other confirm dialogs.
  • Fixes labels and buttons drawn with the theme's text color.
  • Only in dark mode. The mod asks Notepad++ whether dark mode is on, so light mode dialogs are left alone. Needs Notepad++ 8.4.1 or newer.
  • Only touches Notepad++. No other app is affected, and nothing is changed on disk.
